title: Remove Command Block Feedback || Easy || All Editions
topic: Command blocks execute hone par chat mein baar-baar status/output messages aa rahe hain?
description: Command blocks execute hone par chat mein baar-baar status/output messages aa rahe hain? Minecraft ka Command Block Feedback / command block output gamerule in messages ko control karta hai. Is video ka goal chat ko cleaner rakhne ke liye command block output disable karna hai — command blocks ko completely turn off karna nahi.
